o.text: Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish اوكرنمك (ögränmäk), from Proto-Turkic *ögren-. Cognate with Turkish öğrenmek, see there for more cognates.
From Proto-Turkic *tülki, *tilkü (“fox”). Cognate with Turkish tilki, Bashkir төлкө (tülkü) etc.
From bağla- + -ma. The sense 'musical instrument' is from Turkish bağlama.
